submission.justification: Radiator-R3 at 2 cm thickness is recommended as it achieves the best pion/kaon separation performance (3.834σ at 10 GeV/c) among all viable options. Radiator-R2, despite showing higher separation potential in initial tests (4.6σ at 3 cm), fails the mandatory humidity aging constraint and is therefore eliminated. Radiator-R1, while passing all constraints, delivers significantly lower separation (2.931σ at optimal 4 cm thickness) compared to R3. The 2 cm thickness for R3 was determined through systematic optimization, testing thicknesses from 1-6 cm in 1 cm steps, followed by finer 0.5 cm resolution around the optimum, confirming 2 cm as the peak performance configuration.
